packageRules.description: Auto-merge non-major @nanobpm/* updates once CI is green. These are first-party packages we publish from nano-ide; CI (typecheck + test) is the gate. For 0.x pins a caret range locks the minor, so Renovate's range bump is what actually pulls a new minor through; automerging it keeps nwf on the latest urban without manual PRs. platformAutomerge is off because main is unprotected, so Renovate waits for its own green branch status before merging.
Major @nanobpm/* updates may be breaking - require a human to review and merge.
